hardware: NVIDIA Jetson AGX Xavier (32GB ARM64, 8-core Carmel CPU @ 2.2GHz)

recheck_findings.latency_qualification: Cold graph load takes 130-730 ms. Warm single-model inference is 45-105 ms. 5-model ADMET-AI ensemble is ~195 ms. Full panel is ~1.57 s. In-memory cache is sub-millisecond (< 0.1 ms).
recheck_findings.smartcyp_qualification: SMARTCyp uses precomputed DFT (B3LYP/6-31G*) activation energies combined with 2D/3D steric accessibility; it does not invoke runtime DFT calculations.
recheck_findings.model_independence_qualification: Admetica and ADMET-AI share Chemprop D-MPNN architectures and benchmark datasets (AqSolDB, Caco-2, AID 1851, hERG). They receive a 0.55 diversity penalty factor to prevent artificial double-counting.
